blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — House prosecutors are ready to turn over the trove of evidence they collected for Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. However, the panel prefers to await a formal subpoena before surrendering the files, Batangas Rep. Gerville Luistro said on Tuesday. Luistro, the chief prosecutor, said the team will promptly respond to a formal request for the records involving the withdrawn impeachment articles. These articles cover the vice president’s alleged threats against President Marcos, secret fund misuse, and bribery. “We have expressed already our willingness to respond to the request of the ombudsman.
